rv.q: Frederic Chopin, as created by Hershey Felder, is captivating, humorous and humane.
I could go on, but the musical and dramatic magic of this show must be heard and seen as Felder brings Chopin to vivid life.
When Felder plays, the piano definitely sings.
Still, 'Monsieur Chopin' — one of the many tributes to master composers Felder has created over nearly three decades — is as enjoyable today as it was 19 years ago when he introduced it to Chicago.
To not experience Hershey Felder in "Monsieur Chopin" is to deprive yourself of greatness.
If you are into classical music, you don't want to miss this amazing production as you watch Hershey Felder become "Monsieur Chopin".
Felder's amazing dexterity at the piano and his ability to enthrall audiences with his interpretation of Chopin's musical compositions and tragic life.
Felder does not perform often in Chicago, so this is a rare opportunity to experience his brilliance on stage.
